recognize_zh: 淋巴結內有多個淡染、星芒狀至地圖狀的壞死區，中央為含嗜中性球與核碎片的微膿瘍（microabscess），周圍由呈柵欄狀排列的類上皮組織球包圍，這種「化膿性肉芽腫」型態強烈提示貓抓病（Bartonella henselae）。
features: Multiple pale, stellate to rounded necrotizing granulomas within the lymph node with a thickened fibrotic capsule
Central suppurative necrosis with numerous neutrophils and abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris (microabscesses)
Rim of palisading epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Fibrinoid eosinophilic necrotic material at the interface between histiocyte rim and abscess
No caseation, no Langerhans giant cells and no sheets of plasmacytoid dendritic cells or crescentic histiocytes in the fields shown
describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows partial effacement by multiple stellate and rounded necrotizing granulomas beneath a thickened, fibrotic capsule. At higher power, the lesions consist of central suppurative necrosis containing neutrophils and abundant karyorrhectic debris, surrounded by a palisading rim of epithelioid histiocytes. Caseous necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not prominent, and no neoplastic infiltrate is identified. Special stains for AFB and fungi were reported negative, with bacilli demonstrated on Steiner silver stain. Findings are consistent with necrotizing suppurative granulomatous lymphadenitis compatible with cat scratch disease.

ddx.vs: Necrosis is karyorrhectic with crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells but characteristically lacks neutrophils and a palisading epithelioid granulomatous rim.
Shows caseating granulomas with Langhans giant cells and fewer neutrophils, with AFB stain or culture positivity rather than Warthin-Starry/Steiner-positive bacilli.
These produce morphologically identical stellate suppurative granulomas and are separated by exposure history, serology or PCR rather than by histology.
Organisms are usually visible within histiocytes or necrosis on GMS/PAS stains, which were negative here.

captions: Low power: lymph node with stellate necrotizing granulomas beneath a thickened capsule
High power: central microabscess with neutrophils and karyorrhectic debris bordered by epithelioid histiocytes
Palisading epithelioid histiocytes rimming the suppurative necrotic center
